dct_description_sm: Honduras administrative level 0-2 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 2 levels: - Admin 1: 18 - Admin 2: 298 Dates associated with this dataset: - 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 05 October 2016: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 25 June 2015: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 25 June 2015: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Latin America and the Caribbean (ROLAC)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-rolac). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
dct_publisher_sm: Sistema Nacional de Información Territorial (SINIT), Secretaria Técnica de Planificación y Cooperación Externa (SEPLAN), 2010
